stage: New frozen masked-conditioning mechanism screen after completed reference/context v2; same observed development cases, not independent replication
scaffold: Unchanged fixed_r0 ResShift outputs from context_support_v1, with source/input/seed/output hashes verified. All original visible bytes preserved.
restorer: Pinned author ReF-LDM with 50 uniform_trailing DDIM steps, eta zero, CFG 1.5, float32, four supplied references
reference_ablation: Zero the encoded reference condition, retaining the scaffold, noise and all other parameters. Both CFG branches then have the same reference condition.
mechanism: Suppress the scaffold low-quality latent at cells overlapping the supplied missing mask, using conservative max pooling to latent resolution. Keep actual references and late visible-context correction unchanged. Global control multiplies every low-quality latent by one minus the fraction of suppressed cells, matching mean multiplier (not exact latent norm). Reference-disabled masked arm isolates reference benefit. No target/gallery/identity metrics select the mask.
implementation_guard: Preserve author EMA parameter registration (eval and no_grad, not requires_grad mutation); pass corrector_kwargs={}. Author sample does forward this hook, correcting the initial protocol description. Verify full GPU gain-zero equality before experiment.
compute: 24 new ReF-LDM calls, eight unchanged scaffold and eight unchanged reference_context outputs reused from v2. Two full GPU zero-gain equivalence calls retained as a preflight. Same 50 UNet steps and four context corrections for each new arm.
statistics: Average two seeds within identity; eight prespecified paired tests with Holm correction. All failures retained; only fully paired identities in a contrast. Four identities cannot establish statistical superiority.
gate: Each seed: masked_lq_context must improve FaceNet >=0.005 and reduce hole MAE >=1 percent over scaffold, reference_context and global_lq_context; gallery may decrease by <=0.002 and LPIPS increase by <=1 percent. Must improve FaceNet and not worsen MAE versus reference-disabled masked arm. Complete metrics/detection/gallery coverage and visual review required. Failure means no tuning on these targets or expansion of this policy. Passing permits separately frozen unfamiliar-development confirmation only.
interpretation: Masking/conditioning reliability have prior art. This narrow intervention separates generated scaffold conditioning from original visible evidence inside a frozen personal-reference restorer. The VAE is nonlocal: masking cells is not proof of exact semantic locality. No novel superiority claim before controls and independent confirmation.
inference_scope: Only supplied observation, missing mask, references and verified prior scaffold. Clean targets/gallery available solely to separate evaluator and visual review.
